riddle.en: I have no mouth but I drink oil, I have no feet but I chase the dark. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Munh nahi par tel peeta hoon, pair nahi par andhera bhagaata hoon. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I follow you all day, but disappear at night. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Din bhar tumhare peeche chalti hoon, raat ko gaayab. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I have many layers and I make you cry, yet everyone wants me in the kitchen. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Meri kai parat hain, main rulaata hoon, phir bhi rasoi mein sabko chahiye. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I wear a crown and dance in the rain, my feathers have eyes. Who am I?
riddle.hinglish: Sir par mukut, baarish mein naachta hoon, mere pankhon mein aankhein hain. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I am round and made of clay. In summer I keep water cool. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Gol hoon, mitti ka bana hoon. Garmi mein paani thanda rakhta hoon. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I grow fat and thin every month, but I never eat. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Har mahine mota-patla hota hoon, par kabhi khaata nahi. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I open when it rains and close when it stops. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Baarish mein khulta hoon, rukte hi band. Main kaun?

riddle.en: Hard outside, soft white inside, with sweet water hidden in me. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Bahar se sakht, andar safed aur naram, mere andar meetha paani chhupa hai. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I give milk, I say 'moo', and Gopal loved me. Who am I?
riddle.hinglish: Doodh deti hoon, 'baa' bolti hoon, Gopal ki pyaari hoon. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I can be broken without being touched with a hammer, just by saying a word. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Bina chhooye, sirf ek shabd bolne se toot jaata hoon. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I have hands but cannot clap, a face but cannot smile. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Haath hain par taali nahi bajaati, chehra hai par muskuraati nahi. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I wake up the whole village but I never use an alarm. Who am I?
riddle.hinglish: Poore gaon ko jagaata hoon par alarm nahi lagaata. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I eat wood and give you roti. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Lakdi khaata hoon aur tumhe roti deta hoon. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I appear after rain with seven colours, but you can never touch me. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Baarish ke baad saat rangon mein aata hoon, par mujhe koi chhoo nahi sakta. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I am not here yet, but already everyone loves me. Who am I?
riddle.hinglish: Abhi aaya nahi, par sab mujhse pyaar karte hain. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I have one eye but cannot see, I help you sew. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Ek aankh hai par dekh nahi sakti, silaai mein madad karti hoon. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I have many keys but open no door; press me gently and I sing.
riddle.hinglish: Meri bahut chaabiyan hain par koi darwaza nahi kholti; dabaao to main gaata hoon.

riddle.en: I live in a house guarded by thirty-two white soldiers.
riddle.hinglish: Main battees safed sipaahiyon ke pehre mein rehti hoon.

riddle.en: We are a pair; we go everywhere with you but wait outside the temple.
riddle.hinglish: Hum jodi hain; har jagah saath chalte hain par mandir ke bahar ruk jaate hain.

riddle.en: Flowers bloom in the night sky, but no one can pick them.
riddle.hinglish: Raat ke aasmaan mein phool khilte hain, par koi tod nahi sakta.

riddle.en: I copy everything you do, but I never say a word.
riddle.hinglish: Main tumhari har nakal karta hoon, par ek shabd nahi bolta.

riddle.en: Green outside, red inside, with little black seeds that smile.
riddle.hinglish: Bahar se hara, andar se laal, chhote kaale beej muskuraate.

riddle.en: I am white, babies love me, and I become curd overnight.
riddle.hinglish: Main safed hoon, bachche mujhe pyaar karte hain, aur raat bhar mein dahi ban jaata hoon.

riddle.en: I fly without wings and dance on a string.
riddle.hinglish: Bina pankh udti hoon, dhaage par naachti hoon.

riddle.en: Two sisters live on either side of your face, but they never see each other.
riddle.hinglish: Do behnein chehre ke dono taraf rehti hain, par kabhi ek-doosre ko nahi dekhti.

riddle.en: I fall from the sky every year, but I never get hurt.
riddle.hinglish: Main har saal aasmaan se girti hoon, par mujhe chot nahi lagti.

riddle.en: Without me food is sad; too much of me and food is bad.
riddle.hinglish: Mere bina khaana pheeka; zyada ho jaaoon to kharaab.

riddle.en: I wear a yellow coat; monkeys love me and I am soft inside.
riddle.hinglish: Main peela coat pehenta hoon; bandar mujhe pyaar karte hain aur andar se naram hoon.

riddle.en: I have twelve brothers who visit one after another, and then they start again.
riddle.hinglish: Mere baarah bhai ek ke baad ek aate hain, aur phir se shuru ho jaate hain.

riddle.en: I clean the whole house every day, but I never take a bath.
riddle.hinglish: Main roz poora ghar saaf karti hoon, par khud kabhi nahi nahaati.

riddle.en: I have leaves but I am not a tree; open me and I tell you stories.
riddle.hinglish: Mere patte hain par main ped nahi; kholo to kahaniyan sunaati hoon.

riddle.en: I have four legs but no feet; everyone sleeps on me in the courtyard.
riddle.hinglish: Mere chaar pair hain par chal nahi sakti; aangan mein sab mujh par sote hain.

riddle.en: I tie the cow and lift the bucket from the well.
riddle.hinglish: Main gaay baandhti hoon aur kuein se baalti uthaati hoon.

riddle.en: Made from curd and churned with love, Haryana's favourite summer drink.
riddle.hinglish: Dahi se bani, pyaar se biloyi, Haryana ki pasandida garmi ki drink.

riddle.en: Who loves you even before she has seen your face?
riddle.hinglish: Kaun tumhara chehra dekhe bina hi tumse pyaar karti hai?

riddle.en: A white house with no doors, and yellow treasure inside.
riddle.hinglish: Ek safed ghar jismein koi darwaza nahi, andar peela khazaana.
